highlight.title: Digital GCSE exams rolling out from 2026
highlight.summary: <cite index="1-25">AQA, the biggest exam board for GCSEs and A-levels in England, is aiming to roll out on-screen exams over a period of years and it hopes that students will sit at least one major subject digitally by 2030</cite>. <cite index="4-5">From August 2026, all Year 11 pupils will be able to view their examination grades through the Education Record app, marking the first time results will be accessible on mobile phones nationwide</cite>.

resources.title: Oak National Academy Free Online Lessons
resources.why_now: <cite index="17-21,17-22">More than one-third of all teachers used Oak's resources in a 6-month span in 2024, and teachers reported an average time-savings of 4 hours a week when using Oak National Academy</cite>. For both parents and students looking for curriculum-aligned free resources across Y7-Y13.

resources.title: BBC Bitesize New Spring 2026 GCSE Revision Resources
resources.why_now: <cite index="22-2,22-4,22-5">This spring term, students can access a wealth of new exam revision resources covering French, Spanish, Religious Studies, Science, English Literature and Maths</cite> plus new podcasts. For students revising for 2026/2027 GCSEs.

resources.title: Ofqual GCSE Maths/Science Formula Sheets Consultation
resources.why_now: <cite index="3-10,6-17">DfE has confirmed students don't need to memorise formulae for GCSE maths and equations for physics/combined science for the lifetime of current specs</cite> - formula sheets available September 2025. For parents and Y10/11 students planning revision strategies.

resources.title: New UK National Curriculum Changes From 2028
resources.why_now: <cite index="37-2,37-4,37-6">The new curriculum will be implemented in full, for first teaching from September 2028</cite> with major changes including digital literacy for primaries and new reading tests in Y8. For parents of Y7-Y9 students to understand upcoming changes.

claude_take: The digital transformation of UK education is accelerating rapidly with both digital exams and results delivery modernising by 2026-2030. However, the continued provision of formula sheets through 2027 shows pragmatic flexibility, reducing memorisation pressure while maintaining assessment rigour - a welcome balance for families managing exam stress.
